 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.75*w]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) >= 0.75*h]
    # Keep the grid's separator coordinates; special-colored intersections encode
    # the output when all four corners of a tile carry the same color.
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            row.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != line and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # Grid-line color is nearly uniform along recurring full-width/full-height
    # separators, unlike the fill color.

        cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) >= 0.9 * h]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) >= 0.9 * w]

    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            markers = [v for v in corners if v != line]
            outrow.append(markers[0] if len(markers) == 4 and len(set(markers)) == 1 else bg)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
"
}
